errors.evidence: The description states that the blue sector ('Изцяло е интегриран') represents approximately 11%, but the figure and reference indicate it is 10%.
The description states that the orange sector ('Много добре е интегриран') represents approximately 28%, but the figure and reference indicate it is 24%.
The description states that the green sector ('Добре е интегриран') represents approximately 29%, but the figure and reference indicate it is 25%.
The description states that the red sector ('Слабо е интегриран') represents approximately 9%, but the figure and reference indicate it is 8%.
The description states that the purple sector ('Не е интегриран такъв подход') represents approximately 23%, but the figure and reference indicate it is 20%.
The description does not mention that the sectors are ordered by size, as stated in the reference.
The description incorrectly states that percentages are not visible inside the sectors, but the figure clearly shows numerical values inside each sector.
